text:
🇲🇽🌎 TRUMP HITS T-MEC PARTNER CANADA WITH 50% TARIFFS

As Mexico's own T-MEC review grinds on in the capital, Trump slapped a 50% tariff on Canada — autos, alcohol, dairy — invoking a 1930 trade law, reportedly because Ottawa "retaliated" against earlier tariffs. Energy and critical minerals were spared. The lesson from Washington's north: even the closest ally gets the whip. Sheinbaum's cabeza fría looks wiser by the day.

🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO ARRESTS US CITIZEN WANTED BY WASHINGTON — ON ITS OWN TERMS

Marines, the FGR and migration agents captured Janero Van "N", a US citizen tied to Los Chapitos and wanted in Michigan for drug trafficking — one of Washington's 10 priority targets — in Mazatlán. The capture came through intelligence-sharing with the DEA, not US boots on Mexican soil: cooperation, not subordination. Security chief Harfuch confirmed it.

🔥🇲🇽 PAN FLOATS STRIPPING WOMEN OF THE VOTE — SHEINBAUM: "DEEP HATRED FOR THE PEOPLE"

Mexico's right-wing PAN floated conditioning the vote on a civics exam and even rolling back women's suffrage. Sheinbaum called it authoritarian and "a deep hatred for the people": "On election day the vote of Mexico's richest man is worth exactly the same as that of the poorest person." Mexican women only won the vote in the 1950s — after a fight the PAN would now reverse.

🇲🇽🔍 ZAPATISTAS TO CAMP IN MEXICO CITY ALL DECEMBER FOR MOTHERS OF THE DISAPPEARED

The EZLN announced it will base itself in Mexico City throughout December to stand with the madres buscadoras — the mothers digging through Mexico's soil for their disappeared children. "In the mountains of Mexico's southeast we share your pain, and above all your determination for truth and justice," wrote Subcomandante Moisés. They'll stay at the Samir Flores house, hosted by the capital's Otomí community.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICAN STUDENT WINS TOP WOMEN'S PRIZE AT WORLD MATH OLYMPIAD IN CHINA

A student from Morelos, Andrea Cascante, just won the Maryam Mirzakhani Prize — the top honor for women mathematicians by continent — at the 67th International Math Olympiad in Shanghai, where Mexico's team took 5 bronze medals and an honorable mention. The prize is named for the only woman ever to win the Fields Medal, math's Nobel.

🇲🇽📉 <u>MEXICO'S INFLATION IS NOW LOWER THAN WASHINGTON'S</u>

Mexico closed June at 3.37% annual inflation, down from 3.94% in May — and below the United States' 3.53% for the same month. Banxico's inflation "traffic light" flipped green for the first time since 2020. Sheinbaum credited steady food and gasoline prices; the peso gained ground as the dollar softened on US data.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>WHILE THE US EVICTS, MEXICO HANDS OUT DEEDS</u>

In Playa del Carmen, President Sheinbaum handed 504 families their property titles and deeds on July 18 — legal certainty over homes they already live in — part of a national drive to issue one million titles. The Vivienda para el Bienestar program is building 1.8 million new homes this term, 57,000 in Quintana Roo alone.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>MEXICO SKIPPED WASHINGTON'S ANTI-LEFT SUMMIT — CUBA'S AMBASSADOR EXPLAINS WHY</u>

Days after Sheinbaum refused to join a US-convened summit "against the left" — "the political shouldn't be mixed with security" — Cuba's ambassador to Mexico laid out the stakes to Contralínea: Washington reaches for "every mechanism of domination possible to subjugate countries." Nearly 70 years of blockade, around 40 fresh Trump-era sanctions, and Cuba still doesn't ask permission. Neither does Mexico.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>THE US WANTS "MADE IN USA" STAMPED ON NORTH AMERICAN CARS</u>

The third round of the T-MEC review opens in Mexico City this week — US Trade Rep Jamieson Greer lands at Palacio Nacional July 22. Washington's ask: every vehicle built in North America must carry 50% US-specific content, a rule that would push regional content requirements to 82%. Mexico, now the top US trading partner, has cut pending disputes from 54 to 14 and negotiates from strength. Sheinbaum on Trump's method: it "is to raise tariffs on everyone. It's no secret."

🚨🇲🇽 <u>WASHINGTON DOESN'T GET A VOTE ON WHO MEXICO EXPELS</u>

The US State Department went public on July 20 with a report claiming Russian intelligence operates under diplomatic cover in Mexico — reviving Gen. VanHerck's 2022 line that Mexico hosts Russia's "largest" spy base in the world. Sheinbaum's answer hasn't moved: the real sovereignty breach is US agents operating on Mexican soil without notice, and as she puts it, "in Mexico, we decide who's in charge."
